Governor Katie Hobbs Declares State of Emergency in Response to Oxbow Bridge Collapse. From the release: Phoenix, AZ - Governor Katie Hobbs declared a State of Emergency in La Paz County in response to the destruction of the Oxbow Bridge, which collapsed into the Colorado River after it was burned by a wildfire.

Governor Katie Hobbs Declares Heat State of Emergency. From the release: Signs Executive Order to Ensure Future Heat Preparedness and Announces Cooling Centers on Capitol Mall Phoenix, AZ - After 30 consecutive days of excessive heat warnings in Coconino, Maricopa, and Pinal counties, Governor Katie Hobbs has declared a State of Emergency to support local heat relief efforts.
